title: Thalamic local field potentials during reading aloud of words and nonwords (Wang et al., 2022): 11 essential tremor patients, DBS surgery (derivative: preprocessed epochs)
description: Derivative dataset of thalamic local field potentials recorded intraoperatively from the ventral lateral thalamus of 11 essential tremor patients during deep brain stimulation lead implantation. Patients read aloud consonant-vowel-consonant words and nonwords, with recordings from mapping-track macroelectrodes or implanted DBS leads. The release contains the authors' preprocessed, epoched, non-re-referenced trials repackaged in BIDS iEEG format with MNI contact coordinates and trial tables.
methods_description: Recordings were made during awake DBS surgery using either Neuro Omega mapping macroelectrodes (44 kHz sampling) or Medtronic 3387 DBS leads with a Ripple Grapevine processor (30 kHz). Signals were notch-filtered, resampled to 1 kHz, band-limited to 2-400 Hz, and epoched around each trial. Contacts were localized with Lead-DBS and normalized to MNI ICBM152 NLIN 2009b space.
